# Toledo Citizen Platform

Purpose: help citizens turn lived experience into usable knowledge and safe next actions with AI first and institutions only when necessary.

## Read first
https://github.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL_COMPILER.md

## Mathematical authority
Upstream: https://github.com/morrocwi/toledo
Citizen-bridge registry: registry/proposals/TOLEDO_CITIZEN_BRIDGE_v0.17.json
Pinned proposal commit: 361546c934829de56f3dcff2032c740209de847a
Current status: proposal/new derivation unless upstream says otherwise.

## Machine-readable equation mirror
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/main/registry/equation-index.json

Use equation IDs directly. Preserve each equation's upstream status and provenance.

## Domain-neutral problem grammar
The core does not select protocols by occupation. Preserve occupation/practice as context, not as a bespoke routing branch.

P_C = citizen_problem_verbatim remains immutable. AI may produce multiple candidate signatures, each with provenance. A candidate signature is not a diagnosis and is not promoted merely because AI generated it.

Machine contract:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/morrocwi/toledo.biz/main/packages/schemas/problem-signature.schema.json

Core flow:
P_C -> candidate signatures -> citizen/evidence endorsement -> barrier state -> minimal protocol -> capability need -> optional domain adapter -> provider/world action -> case update.

Unknown and unresolved states are valid outputs. Do not fabricate missing context.

## Closed-loop protocol
Preferred loop:
Citizen input -> initialize_case -> Case Passport -> advance_case -> action/world/institution -> update_case/advance_case with event -> Return Object when external contribution is used -> outcome -> STOP.

The Case Passport is caller-held in the public reference runtime. Do not assume this repository is a sensitive-data store.

P_C = citizen_problem_verbatim is immutable under ordinary events. P_S and P_D are separate representations.

Local citizen+AI/world cases may close without a fake institutional Return Object when no external actor was used and safety/authority constraints are satisfied. External routes still require the Return Gate.

## API
Reference implementation: apps/protocol_api/main.py
OpenAPI contract: openapi/toledo.protocol.v1.yaml
Important routes:
- /v1/equations
- /v1/protocols/compile
- /v1/cases/init
- /v1/cases/update
- /v1/cases/step
- /v1/institutions
- /v1/handoffs/validate
- /v1/returns/validate
- /v1/schemas/problem-signature

## MCP
Reference server: apps/mcp_server/server.py
Equation tools: get_equation, search_equations
Protocol tools: compile_citizen_protocol, initialize_case, update_case, advance_case
Routing/gate tools: route_institutions, check_handoff, check_return_gate
Resources: toledo://equations/index, toledo://equations/{id}, toledo://protocol/compiler, toledo://protocol/case-lifecycle, toledo://protocol/problem-capability-grammar, toledo://schema/problem-signature, Toledo schemas.

## Invariants
AI-first != AI-only.
Observation != Interpretation != Diagnosis.
Occupation != ProtocolSelector.
ProblemSignature != Diagnosis.
CandidateSignature != EndorsedSignature.
Academic capability != University executability.
Referral != Handoff != Collaboration.
Institutional output != Citizen outcome.
Route failure != case restart.
Do not overwrite P_C, the citizen problem verbatim.
Do not treat proposal equations as validated universal laws.
